answer: Admission auction: the registry auctions timber lots, one per identity, bids sealed under the bidder key. The lots are cut in one canyon; a second lot from one purse costs more. An echo betrays a shill: duplicate bids echo on the board, void, and burn the 70-credit bond. First lot 47, k-th 47+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,043,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented paddles fail: lots bind to the bidder key. Honest agents pay 47 once, keep bond and share.
